rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an accident that results in death, rather than for the person who dies.

example.english: This fatality caused the whole construction site to shut down.
example.traditional: 呢宗致命意外令成個工地停工。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung1 zi3 ming6 ji3 ngoi6 ling6 seng4 go3 gung1 dei6 ting4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for the person who was killed or died, rather than for the accident itself.

example.english: The report said there was one fatality after the crash.
example.traditional: 車禍之後，報道話有一個死咗嘅人。
example.jyutping: ce1 wo6 zi1 hau6 bou3 dou6 waa6 jau5 jat1 go3 sei2 zo2 ge3 jan4
